//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Custom Credits -> Config

Enable Custom Credits.//: Whether Custom Credits is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

showMinecraftLogoInCredits.//: Whether the Minecraft logo should be shown at the top of the credits screen.
